A Melbourne principal's staffy Juno is fading fast. Chris brings her to Sydney for a CT scan revealing a condition so rare only 20 cases exist worldwide—her blood vessels are all mixed up and she needs high-risk surgery.

Ziggy the cat has a big problem - he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats' deteriorating health is not compromised further.

Chris heads to Cornwall, UK. He's flat-out treating a dairy calf needing urgent surgery, a prize-winning duck with a torn foot, and a Siberian eagle owl with a bung eye, and giving two Atlantic grey seals the all-clear for release.

In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3-day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

TAPS responds to a call from the night custodian at the Clapp Library in Belchertown, MA, whose solo shift has been graced by a few unearthly visitors. Then, the team investigates a house that sits on a 300 year old Massachusetts property where strange activity has plagued four generations of a local family.

The TAPS investigators travel to the notoriously haunted Civil War site of Gettysburg, Pennsylvania where they attempt to capture the voices and apparitions of dead soldiers that reportedly haunt the Cashtown Inn and walk its hallways.

Locals claim that a series of strange noise and smells come from Prospect Place in Trinway, Ohio, known as a part of the historic Underground Railroad; strange sights haunt a family in Massachusetts and the TAPS team tries to help.

TAPS answers a call from the United States Air Force to investigate the Wright-Patterson base in Dayton, Ohio, one of the oldest and largest military installations in the country. Over the years, stories of inexplicable encounters and incidents have been passed on from employee to employee.
TAPS investigates the Ruff Stone Tavern in North Providence, R.I. and the Mount Washington Resort in New Hampshire.

In this episode, TAPS heads to Nevada to search for spirits of the Old West. First stop is the old mining town of Goldfield, where Jason, Grant and the rest of the team investigate one of the most requested locations in Ghost Hunters history Â- the Goldfield Hotel. Then the team travels north to Virginia City, once a thriving metropolis with a population of over 30,000. Now, the city is a ghost of its former self.

Grant, Jay and the rest of the TAPS team head to the Weston State Hospital, a now abandoned psychiatric facility in West Virginia, to investigate if the claims about the building are true; volunteers have reported seeing strange occurrences.

Jason, Grant and the TAPS team head to New England to answer a call from a terrified family plagued by mysterious apparitions. During their investigation, TAPS uncovers some shocking evidence of paranormal activity in the home. From there, they take on claims at the Palace Theater in Manchester, NH, a former vaudeville stop.

The Taps team heads to the coasts to tackle with two investigations. First they travel to Massachusetts to visit the Colonial Inn at Cape Cod. Then they head over to California to investigate the Moss Beach Distillery.

Grant, Jason and the TAPS team head to New Jersey for their next investigation into the paranormal as they spend the night in the home of the last royal governor and look for evidence of hauntings before they examine the Red Mill Museum.

TAPS embarks on an investigation at Fort Delaware, built in the mid-1800?s and primarily used as an artillery defense for the Union during the Civil War. It eventually became a Civil War POW camp, housing over 33,000 Confederate soldiers. The conditions at Fort Delaware were grim, and it soon gained a reputation in the Confederacy as a ?black hole.?

A local preservation society took over this property in 2000, and discovered over 30 boxes of unclaimed human remains tucked away in the basement bathroom. Renovations unearthed remnants of the Episcopal church as well as light fixtures and stained glass that'd been hidden behind the walls and ceilings as if the original funeral director created a building within a building.

TAPS goes to Connecticut to unravel the mysteries at the historic Pettibone Tavern. Built in 1780, the tavern originally served as a carriage stop between Albany and Boston during the late 18th century. During this time, it was also supposedly the site of a brutal axe murder, and through the years, employees have consistently reported activity that they cannot explain.
TAPS visits a 16th century North Kingstown, R.I., landmark to solve an awful mystery. Then, TAPS comes to help a military family living in Groton, Conn.

TAPS visits the abandoned (and skeevy) remains of an art-deco masterpiece, Buffalo Central Terminal. The terminal, a 14-story combination office tower/train station, opened in 1929 and closed 50 years later. After falling through the hands of various owners, the Central Terminal Restoration Corp. acquired it in 1997. In the years since the Terminal's abandonment, it has become a potent source of paranormal stories.

In the 17th century, a man set out to prove God existed using science. Robert Boyle, father of modern chemistry, shaped the scientific method and predicted science’s future in a near-supernatural way.

With little resources to fight a legal battle, Percy joins forces with up-and-coming attorney Jackson Weaver and environmental activist Rebecca Salcau for a monumental case that leads all the way to the Supreme Court.

Comedy All-Stars brings together a lineup of hilarious, family-friendly comedians for a night of clean, feel-good laughter. Featuring top talent who prove you don’t need crude jokes to be funny, this series delivers quick wit, clever humour, and plenty of joy. From laugh-out-loud stand-up to relatable storytelling, Comedy All-Stars is the perfect reminder that a good laugh really is the best medicine - and it’s even better when you can share it with the whole family.

Reading the Bible and truly meditating on it aren't the same. Today, Joyce shows how letting God's Word take root in your heart gives you the strength to forgive others.

Can one hour a week really change a child's future? In Melbourne, Marion Macaulay proves it can. Through Kids Hope, she's showing how consistent mentorship can be a beacon of hope for young lives. Join Marion as she demonstrates the extraordinary impact of simply being present and caring, week after week.

You live in a physical body In this encouraging message, Pastor Bayless walks through three remarkable stories from Mark chapter 5 that reveal how Jesus brings freedom to the whole person. You’ll see how Christ delivers an oppressed soul, heals a broken body, and even restores life where all hope seemed lost. These stories remind us that no situation is beyond the reach of God’s power. Discover how coming to the feet of Jesus can change everything as you listen today.

p.d: In this interview Dr. David Jeremiah and Sheila Walsh discuss the enemies we face and the weapons we have as we fight, as well as the courage and strength God gives us while we battle.

Bruce Downes is The Catholic Guy. Bruce and his team will move, inspire and challenge you to live your life to the absolute fullest. No matter your age, situation or background, be prepared to laugh, learn and listen to what God is trying to say to you. Bruce travels Australia speaking regularly about his experiences in life and in the Church in a way that is both relatable and easy to understand. Bruce's message of power, impact, freedom and purpose is for anyone and everyone - for no matter where you are around the world today, God is never far from you.
The annual evangelism conference led by Ray Comfort and the Living Waters crew.

Friends and Heroes is an animated children's adventure based in Ancient Egypt, Israel and Rome. The story follows two young friends Macky and Portia as they fight for justice against the Roman Empire.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Your Pasta Sucks: A “Cookbook” by comedian Matteo Lane! Follow along as Shahir prepares eggplant parmigiana, pasta alla pesto trapenese, and risotto allo zafferano!
Chef Dev shares straightforward recipes for street foods that have gained popularity around the world. including Dan Dan Noodles from China. Doner Kebab from Turkey. and Samosas from India.

Chef Shahir Massoud tries recipes from the award-winning cookbook Love Japan by Aaron Israel, Sawako Okochi and Gabriella Gershensen. He makes a chicken katsu sando, blistered shishito peppers, slice-and-bake matcha cookies and more!

Chef Shahir Massoud tries recipes from Irina Georgescu's award-winning cookbook Tava. He prepares Eastern European baked goods like Transylvanian griddle breads, a rich chocolate mousse torte, an 18th-century bread pudding and more!

Long: Maddie and Kiki go head-to-head with a seafood classic! Maddie makes scallops and Parmesan risotto, while Kiki creates a plant-based version with king oyster “scallops” and bulgur risotto. Two sisters, two delicious takes.

Host Michael Bonacini explores the Venetian region's bounty from sea to land — serving soft shell crab with tangy sundried tomato aioli, radicchio risotto, pancetta-wrapped snapper with pea mash, and a giant almond crumb biscuit to finish.
Piemonte cuisine is influenced by its mountainous terrain. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us how to make its warm regional dishes like Bagna Cauda.
Charming host Michael Bonacini inspires us to make simple, flavorful dishes from the rustic Italian region, Umbria.
With just a few key ingredients, each minimal dish proves that balance, technique, and a simple approach can create satisfying griddle dishes full of pure, honest flavor.

Bustling markets and sizzling sounds inspire a griddled tour of street food. From sweet to savory, each dish captures the rhythm of streets worldwide reflecting the traditions and bold character of flavors everywhere.

Maddie and Kiki fire up the BBQ Barn for a smoky, summery feast with wild rice and grilled asparagus salad, spicy beer can jerk chicken, sweet grilled corn with orange butter, and crispy cinnamon sugar doughnuts.
Maddie and Kiki bring a fresh BBQ Barn feast to the grill with apricot-Dijon stuffed pork chops, charred fennel with anchovy garlic butter, and a juicy watermelon salad with feta, olives, and herbs.

Italian chef and food guru Vanessa Gianfrancesco teaches us how to make fresh pasta like an Italian, and then uses that pasta to create everything from fettucine alfredo to tortelloni to lasagna bianca.

After selecting olives and onions as his special ingredients, the chef uses caramelized onions to prepare a batch of French onion soup before then creating a Moroccan-inspired chicken dish that uses olives to create a tart flavor.
Nothing says comfort food better than fried chicken. Chef Spencer Watts shows us all the fixings for a fast, easy, and delicious fried chicken night.

p.t: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted
p.d: For decades, Claire Sweeney has sensed a presence in her apartment. A mysterious figure is regularly sighted in her hallway. What will the team find?

Corine, Leanne and Kelly search for answers in Massachusetts, uncovering what Salem's ghosts reveal about the infamous witch trials, before receiving a chilling message from a man executed in the most gruesome way imaginable.

Call out to the pirates who once ran this South Carolina port city. Make a fascinating discovery about a famed buccaneer hunter, relive a ghostly bedroom visit in an 18th-century tavern, then confront the gentleman spirit that keeps haunting Corine.
Cross paths with lost souls that wander the stormy streets of the Big Easy.
Explore an eerie Newfoundland isle where spirits from WW II cry out for peace.

Paranormal investigators Corine, Leanne and Kelly tap into the bloody history of one of Ireland's ghostliest spots, and they find out who, or what, is lurking in the shadows of this terrifying fortress, which could be a portal to the underworld.

Confront the bloody, greedy past of Benham, Kentucky, where an ominous mountain and a historic mining conflict have made the land a hotbed of paranormal activity. Explore three ghostly gathering places and discover what connects them.

The team hunts for restless souls in a coal mine near a purported mass grave. After a series of paranormal experiments, they find out if a living man's visits are keeping a spirit attached to the mine.

The team studies the branches of a haunted family tree at Brennan House in Louisville, Kentucky, and learn why the successful childless clan always returned home to die—and if they've never really left.

Meet Richard Cirese, a mayor who’s deeply invested in the preservation of a town with a tragic past. Explore a nearby river and railroad tracks to see if they are responsible for paranormal activity that both locals and visitors have witnessed.
Discover new types of ghosts, like the one that saved Honey’s son’s life.
Get to know people who are too scared to go home thanks to ghosts.
See one spooky encounter in a graveyard and another near a temple of the dead.
Watch a couple speculate about the life of a judge who now haunts their home.
See how two women’s lives turned around when ghosts made them promises.

Gordon tasks the final five contestants with teaching others how to cook by recreating one of his favorite dishes using only their verbal communication skills; the chef's students struggle to match professional-grade cuisine on their own.
World renowned chef Gordon Ramsay puts the remaining young chefs through rigorous and devastating challenges at his restaurant in Hollywood.

In an intense battle between the two remaining chefs as they tackle the final dinner service and a few other tests. It's the concluding competition for the position of head chef at Gordon Ramsay Steak in Las Vegas.
US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. The competition concludes as the two finalists battle it out for the position of head chef at Gordon Ramsay Steak at the Paris Las Vegas.

Twenty aspiring chefs divide into teams of men and women and try to impress Chef Gordon Ramsay with their signature dish; the winning team gets to sit down to dinner with Ramsay while the losers are left to clean up the kitchen.

Chef Ramsay sets up a tricycle relay race that requires both teams to work in pairs to accomplish basic culinary tasks, and the winning team gets to go to San Francisco while the losing team is relegated to picking carrots at a farm.

The chefs learn about teamwork via a challenge starting with pigs and potatoes and ending in the kitchen, and the winners earn a day aboard a yacht while the losers must bathe livestock; Ramsay kicks a team out of the kitchen during dinner service.

The first team to prepare 10 perfect plates of lobster ravioli gets to relax by the pool at a mansion in Beverly Hills while the other team cleans the kitchen; some contestants excel at delivering a steak dinner to diners and Ramsay berates the rest.

The red and blue teams test their memories when they must match side dishes with four different kinds of protein, and while the winners go to Laguna Beach, the losers prepare honey taffy; the contestants prepare breakfast for a wedding.

Each team picks a leader for the next dinner service, during which they will serve their first VIP guests, but one chef accidentally serves a dish before it is fully cooked; one team sends two chefs to Chef Ramsay for possible elimination.

Pairs from the teams create unique pizza dishes for a chance to win a relaxing day trip to a hotel; at dinner service, the chefs must impress Chef Ramsay's family, but while one team excels, the other runs out of a crucial ingredient.

It's up to the chefs to host the 160th anniversary party for the Phi Mu sorority, and after a southern-inspired menu for the social committee sends one team to Las Vegas, the teams run into communication issues during dinner service for the party.

Joy wonders why Kashia has made it this far in the competition, or even why she qualified for it in the first place, if she is unable to fry chicken; as the clock ticks down, the team members have to create entrees with surprise ingredients.

The contestants go on an unexpected field trip to a Gordon Ramsay restaurant so that they can see what they have to look forward to, then the teams prepare meals from the restaurant's menu, and while one excels, another struggles to communicate.

The team with the best knowledge of pork goes indoor sky-diving while the losing team prepares for dinner service, but while one team has a hard time dividing responsibilities, the other can't coordinate timing, leaving dinner service a disaster.

Take in the moving stories of those who experienced the ferocity of German bombing, as the Luftwaffe targeted the major cities of Britain.

By May 1940, the die was cast and the war started in earnest. This episode examines the buildup to the Battle of Britain, studying the technological advances that the RAF pioneered, to the start of the Battle itself. At the heart of the RAF production were two world-class fighters, the Hurricane and the Spitfire, which were able to compete against the best the Luftwaffe had to offer.

This episode focuses on events from July to early September, 1940. The Germans tried initially to bomb British naval shipping with limited success. However, three separate attacks in August targeting RAF airfields were successful. Biggin Hill, North Weald, and Kenley were all temporarily put out of action. Then, the Germans made a mistake that ultimately lost them the war.

During the first week of September, Hitler decided to move the bombing strategy away from the airfields, to civilian London. This episode examines the spirit of the Londoners who defied Hitler, and ultimately ended the war in the last weeks of September. The RAF, with fewer resources, fewer men, and fewer machines, had beaten the might of the Luftwaffe.

We begin by looking at depictions of The Last Supper including Leonardo da Vinci’s masterpiece; a 6th century mosaic and a modern interpretation by Chris Ofili. We then turn to interpretations of Jesus’ betrayal and trial by artists including Bosch and Tintoretto. Finally, we examine portrayals of Jesus’ final judgement in work by Honoré Daumier and Mark Wallinger.
Our exploration begins in Varallo, northern Italy, where the Stations of the Cross were carved into a series of sculptures and frescoes.
We take a look at works by Giotto, Michelangelo, and Sam Taylor-Wood that depict the mourning over Jesus’ body.

Financing Evil: Who financed Hitler and helped him to achieve power? Here, follow the trail of money to the top and see the secret partnerships that underpinned the evil regime. Part 1 of 4.
The Nazi Economic Miracle: Germany, 1937. Hitler appears to be fulfilling his promise of returning Germany to prosperity—but there was a deeply sinister side to the recovery. Part 2 of 4.

Head out on the hunt for investment properties with Mike and MJ, then discover a surprise that tests their father-son relationship and their business partnership. Stand back as Mike gets a lesson in treating his son as an equal.

Mike eyes a promising live-work-play retreat in a tourist hotspot, but MJ's wary of the commute to this diamond in the rough. Meanwhile, water issues threaten to drain the budget at the Country House.
Things look up at the Country House as a partial second storey takes shape. But at the River House, dangerous structural issues force Mike and MJ's crew to tear down the roof and second-floor walls.

Mike and MJ face major structural and water issues at the river house and decide to take the whole thing down to rebuild it the correct way; at the country house, they continue to solve the water issues but soon notice more water on the ground.

Mike is happy to help after receiving a call from a distraught family who attempted to install a state-of-the-art wheelchair ramp up their home's staircase for their disabled daughter, but he quickly realizes that custom designs don't always work.

Find out how Catherine and Cameron’s contractor turned $10 in staples into $10,000 in roof damage. See the Holmes team revamp even more costly electrical and structural issues he caused and give this couple’s 50-year-old home the update it deserves.

Mike and his crew are called in by the new owners of a century-old home after they discovered a hidden third floor in their new house, but restoring the space to it's former glory proves difficult and they realize why it was sealed off to begin with.

Ingrid suffered an aneurysm after blowing her life savings on a botched reno. Mike steps in to help her daughter Natalie get it done right, with smart tips on writing contracts, choosing toughened glass and preventing leaks.

After his wife passed away, a man's home fell into disrepair when he closed off their bedroom, a part of an old addition that has no foundation or permits, and Mike rebuilds the space with work on a retaining wall, bathroom demo and asbestos removal.

p.t: Holmes 10th Anniversary Special: Behind The Overalls
p.d: Get a humorous, heartfelt look back at 10 years in the life of Canadaâ€™s favourite construction pro, Mike Holmes. See how his TV career began, find out what a typical Holmes crew day is like, and go behind the scenes of Mikeâ€™s best on-air moments.
A satellite dish installer accidentally uncovers a rotten roof. Mike and the team work to stretch Keith and Caitlin's repair budget, filling the gaps left by their previous inspection report.
First-time buyers Todd and Duane suspect their home inspector missed something major. Mike checks out their discovery and weighs whether fixing the blunder will derail their freshly decorated home.
A couple bought their two-storey historical home based on an inspector who found nothing wrong. Now that problems are emerging, they've sought help from Mike Holmes and his team.

A couple stays out of their much-loved, historical home for weeks while Damon and the crew repair problems Mike Holmes finds that the home inspector misses; a house has water coming into it, mold, holes in the foundation and dangerous fireplaces.

Head out on the hunt for investment properties with Mike and MJ, then discover a surprise that tests their father-son relationship and their business partnership. Stand back as Mike gets a lesson in treating his son as an equal.
Undercover officers target suspected meth and heroin dealers, including a dangerous gang member with a prior murder conviction.
Matthew Terry hides a dark and violent side that will have deadly consequences.
A couple finds their friend shot dead and calls 911. Is one of them more foe than friend? Police uncover a trail of deceit.

p.t: American Detective With Lt. Joe Kenda
p.d: When a South Carolina man turns up dead in the Black River, Inv. Morris must figure out who’s lying to him: the victim’s wife or his mistress.

p.t: People Magazine Presents: Crimes Of The 90s
p.d: A sadistic murderer terrorises Dallas in 1991 as a series of women are found murdered with their eyeballs surgically removed.
When Shelley Nance is found stabbed to death, her murder sends the community of Lake Highlands into a panic. A bizarre fatal attraction is soon uncovered.
Close friends from church camp turn out to be vicious murderers.
A gun store robbery ignites a federal investigation into arson, violence, and murder. But soon the detectives come face-to-face with an unlikely killer.
For decades, a predator has been hunting in the shadows. Whispers of missing women, unsolved attacks, and a faceless monster haunt a quiet town.
A strange bond between an adulterous mother and her son leads to murder.
When a suburban husband and father's wife is found murdered, the police investigation reveals his secret double life as a BDSM devotee who is having an affair.

After uncovering alleged new victims, Elizabeth Chambers is hot on the trail of convicted conman Anthony Strangis and ends up face-to-face with him.

In Izmir, Chuck learns the art of Turkish coffee, explores a 17th-century bazaar, harvests olives, and bakes local fish in an ancient stone oven.
In Amman, Chuck eats legendary falafel, explores Petra’s tombs, and joins a Bedouin camp in Wadi Rum to cook Om Ali over a desert fire pit.
London vs. Bangkok: helicopter vs. tuk tuk. Richard checks into a celeb-owned Thai hotel, while Gill enjoys skyline views of St Paul’s. Which capital—and mode of transport—wins Dave’s approval?
Gill explores Amboise, the former French royal residence and Leonardo da Vinci's resting place. Richard tours Sri Lanka's ancient temples and ruins.

Richard seeks Jet Set glory from the Iron Throne in Northern Ireland, even braving a haunted hotel. In Florence, Gill visits Michelangelo’s David and an 18th-century silk factory using Da Vinci’s original machine designs.
Dave faces a tough choice this episode: Gill is in St. Lucia, and Richard in Uga Bay, Sri Lanka—both tropical paradises with golden sands and warm seas.
From Michael Angelo’s David in Florence to elephant safaris in Sri Lanka, this is an art lovers and outdoorsy adventure.
James heads across the pond to discover what life for a blind traveler is like in a world capital like London.
Escaping the hustle and bustle of the big city, James takes the train to visit the rest of England, from ghost tours and hiking in Scotland, to football in Liverpool, to an epic thrill ride in Wales.
Eric Hanson heads to the UK to explore the rugged Wales Coast Path—an 870-mile hiking trail that offers stunning views and adventure along one of the most dramatic coastlines in the world.
Eric Hanson travels to the far eastern edge of North America to discover the beauty of Newfoundland and explore the stunning East Coast Trail.
Eric Hanson heads down under and puts his outdoor skills to the ultimate test as he challenges rugged mountain trails during spectacularly bad weather in New South Wales, Australia.
Eric Hanson laces up his hiking boots to explore some of California’s most iconic wilderness, including Yosemite National Park, the Mojave Desert and Butte County.
A Romantic trip to Colorado takes a windy turn when Jason pushes Tayler despite her hesitation to summit Mt. Democrat in 70 mph winds and -19 degree weather.
Jason's a thrill-seeking mountain biker, Tayler's a book-loving planner—polar opposites thrown together on adventures that leave them wondering if they have anything in common.

Possibly the home of the deadly Marberg Ebola virus, Kitum Cave is high on Mt.Elgon straddling the Kenya-Uganda border. When host George Kourounis gets bitten by one of the bats…well, you’ll have to see the show to find out what happens.

No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size.

George explores the volcanoes of Costa Rica with an international team of scientists, rafts down whitewater rivers in full flood, canyoneers down raging waterfalls, and handles some of deadliest snakes this tropical country has to offer.
An iconic knife that's been an integral part of military culture for more than a hundred years, the Swiss Army Knife has been put in service around the world – and even in space.
Dr Jack meets a man who has defied all odds by miraculously recovering from severe brain damage, after a car crash left him lying in a coma for three months.
In this episode we explore the science of persuasion and discover that even a hardened sceptic can be convinced – Dr Jack himself included.
In this episode, Dr Jack Lewis investigates the neuroscience behind genius. He meets a genuine genius, Sabrina Chevannes, a woman with an IQ of 178 at just 4.
We explore the environmental consequences of war and how different people, from Rohingya refugees to Syrian scientists, are trying to restore a healthy relationship with nature.
We explore potential new strategies to satisfy the growing food demand, from restaurants growing potatoes in the air to jellyfish as a potential sustainable meat alternative.

Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the island's forests.

Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry season ends and the monsoon storms begin.

In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent - Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the park's establishment gave rhinos a lifeline - breeding them back from extinction.

This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

Join Chris at Victoria’s Kyabram Vet Clinic, where he helps a pregnant cow survive a difficult labour and saves a Maltese terrier’s unborn pups. Back in Sydney, Tim tries to assist a magnificent peregrine falcon that’s been grounded.

Go on a team retreat with Tammy as she helps everyone regroup after the tragic death of the barn's first foal. Witness the frustration as the group struggles to communicate, before Tammy takes Megan to task over her bad attitude.

Get a ringside seat at the most important equestrian event of the season, where Allie’s best efforts aren’t enough to bring home an award. Watch the day go from bad to worse when Tammy and Megan get into yet another monumental argument.

Two diminutive orphan animals experience a difficult time with survival as they do whatever they possibly can to stay alive; Hope decides to give a release another attempt after the first try did not go as they initially planned.
A most unusual fawn arrives on Hope's doorstep. A graveyard is the spooky setting for an unlikely reunion.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Jamie and Adam look to answer the question lurking in the back of the mind of anyone who's ridden an elevator in a high rise building: If this suddenly falls, can I save myself by jumping up just as it's about to hit bottom?

While carrying a sheet of plywood, high up on a skyscraper construction site, a builder is caught by a gust of wind. The plywood acts like a sail and blows him off the building. However, the builder hangs on, steers the plywood like a hang-glider, and lands back in the building a few floors down. Well, that’s what the myth says.
The mythbusters love movie myths, and this episode features two film favorites.
In this episode, the Mythbusters tackle three new myths, each with the real potential to cause injury, or death. But then, Jamie and Adam wouldn’t have it any other way.
In this episode Adam and Jamie and the build team test out separate but similar myths, as they try to float heavy objects in unorthodox fashion. Welcome to the float-athon!
On this episode, get set for the biggest, most insane build the guys have attempted.
In this episode of Mythbusters, Jamie and Adam tackle exploding houses, dig deep into an old figure of speech, and find out just what it takes to get your garden up and jumping.

In this power-crazed episode, Adam and Jamie pit themselves against the law of gravity as they try to launch Buster into space - with fireworks. And in the myth of free energy they're up against all the known laws of science as they attempt to build a perpetual motion machine. Meanwhile the build team embark on a ghoulish myth that will turn your head, and Kari's stomach - the Killer Fan.
The Mythbusters begin this episode by once again taking aim at a classic movie myth. Can you really be Blown Away in a gunfight?

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie go head to head in a madcap Mexican jailbreak jaunt. And brace yourselves for the biggest bang ever on Mythbusters - by a mile - when Adam, Jamie and 850 pounds of high explosive join forces with the FBI to wreak their revenge on a stubborn cement truck.
In the myth a car breaks its drive shaft at the front universal joint. The drive shaft drops into a pothole and lifts the car into the air – much like a pole vault.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie try a test with a ton of toast, the build team head up a myth that’s one big yawn, and the whole gang decamp to Lake Tahoe for the most mismatched motor car race of all time.

This episode of MythBusters answers three diverse questions. Those with an eye for history will learn whether or not a crude form of battery was invented more than 2000 years ago. Those interested in technology will learn how to rebuild a crash test dummy. And everybody else will learn the fastest way to cool a six-pack of beer.

Myths tested: Could using a phone in a thunderstorm result in being electrocuted? Could a bullet pass through a man's genitals, into a woman's abdomen, and make the woman pregnant? Can a boat be driven with its trailer still attached?

The build team are testing out a story that could bring every household to its knees! Can the humble vacuum cleaner beloved by housewives and husbands for over 100 years, be turned into something altogether more terrifying?

Captain Michelle Bancewicz of the No Limits takes a huge risk traveling ninety miles in the hopes of finally catching their first blue fin tuna of the season. Proving they’ll do whatever it takes to get a paycheck, the No Limits finally lands a 105-inch blue fin. Closer to Gloucester, F/V Tuna Dot Com strikes blue gold on crowded fishing grounds with the heaviest fish of the season so far.

The season is off to a fishy start, but two captains struggle to gain ground. Captain Jack Patrician of the Time Flies has been on a tough losing streak as he and mate, Anders Strickland, grapple to find their groove as a new team. Meanwhile Captain Michelle Bancewicz needs to trust her gut instead of following the crowd.

Halfway through the season, the DotCom, Wicked Pissah alliance continues to be a force to be reckoned when Paul saves Dave from disaster on the water and reaps the good karma that comes with it. Meanwhile, the rest of the fleet pulls out all the stops in hopes of making up ground in the standings before it’s too late.

With captains Dave on Dot.com and Paul on Wicked Pissah working together and leading the fleet, middle-of-the-pack Captain Jack and new mate Anders on Time Flies go it alone, gunning for the front runners as they battle monster bluefin. Meanwhile, Tyler on Pinwheel and Marciano on Hard Merchandise form their own alliance seeking to gain an advantage.

Former champion Bob Cook on the Fat Tuna sits behind four boats on the leaderboard. With the quota for blue fin tuna season rapidly dwindling, he breaks out of the pack catching two fish and makes a run for the number one position. Meanwhile, the alliance between Wicked Pissah and F/V Tuna Dot Com remains strong and keeps them both at the top of the fleet.

With the quota getting smaller everyday, the fleet fights to make big moves. But while Dot Com, Fat Tuna and Wicked Pissah battle for the top, the duo on Pinwheel is hit with a series of hardships. After a brutal loss, Captain Tyler McLaughlin is scratched by his cat, forcing him to seek medical attention and then boat malfunctions keep him stuck on land.

With the quota rapidly dwindling Fat Tuna fights to hold on to their razor thin lead over Wicked Pissah and DotCom as alliance mates Paul And Dave continue to work together to try and regain the top spot. Meanwhile, the rest of the fleet races to close the gap as they hold out hope for a late season comeback.
On the season finale, Wicked Pissah, and Fat Tuna battle it out for the top spot.

After a stellar North Atlantic fishing season, some of New England's best bluefin tuna fishermen head south again to North Carolina's famed Outer Banks in their quest to bank big money. But they'll face some serious competition from the local southern fleet, especially from local fishing legend Charlie Griffin, captain of Reels of Fortune. Captain Dave Marciano of Hard Merchandise, Captain Tyler McLaughlin of Pinwheel and Captain TJ Ott of Hot Tuna all made good money during their fishing season up north, but now they're putting it all on the line by making the expensive journey down south and gambling their profits in the hope they'll be able to continue their catching streak. The challenging winter conditions in the Outer Banks make it one of the hardest places to catch bluefin tuna, and, within the first three days on the water, two boats will fall victim to the dangers here.

The treacherous Oregon Inlet, part of the aptly nicknamed Graveyard of the Atlantic in North Carolina's Outer Banks fishing grounds, becomes the site of two boat crashes. Northern vessel Hard Merchandise and the fleet's current leader Reels of Fortune take hard hits, sustain heavy damage and put survival suits to the test. Could this be the end of the season for both Bleufin tuna boats? While out in deep water the rest of the fleet is infiltrated by a surprising new addition -? the big-?talking, all-? female crew of Reel Action, captained by 17-?year veteran fisherwoman, Tami Gray. Will Reel Action usurp the leader or will Fishin' Frenzy, Pin Wheel or Hot Tuna take command of the seas?

When Charlie picks up his boat after mechanics have finished working on the damage, it comes with a 10,000 bill, so now he and his hard-working son Jake must catch that much in fish just to break even. After two back-to-back seasons of being runner-up in New England and North Carolina, confident and cocky young Captain Tyler McLaughlin is determined to finish out the season as the top boat.

At the start of day nine on the water, last season's champion, captain Greg Mayer and his Fishin' Frenzy crew are the top earners the Outer Banks' Bluefin tuna fleet. But their lead is only a slim margin over local rivals Charlie and Jake Griffin, of father-and-son operation Reels of Fortune. The Griffin boys, with a $10,000 boat repair bill still hanging over their heads, are more desperate than ever for a payday. Meanwhile, Captain TJ Ott, of northern boat Hot tuna, is looking for any advantage he can get to turn his mediocre season around, so he reaches out to southern Captain Tami Gray, of all-female team Reel Action, hoping that a new friendship will lead to a wealth of local knowledge. And on Doghouse, Captain Britton Shackelford's chances of landing his second keeper tuna of the season will all come down to whether his greenhorn son Austin can come through in a dangerous situation.

Eleven days into North Carolina's Bluefin tuna season, treacherous winter weather in the Outer Banks fishing grounds forces captains to push their limits. Southern boat Reels of Fortune holds a meager lead over last year's local champion Fishin' Frenzy, while northern boat Hard Merchandise and local all-female team Reel Action have yet to catch a fish.
A crewmember faces a family emergency unfolding on land that tests his resolve on the water.

Charlie Griffin, captain of family operation Reels of Fortune, and Greg Mayer, skipper of last season's top?earning boat Fishin' Frenzy, are neck and neck in the competition for the number one spot in the fleet. Meanwhile struggling Northern vessels Hot Tuna, who has caught only one bluefin so far, and Hard Merchandise, who have yet to land their first fish in southern waters, are desperate to make a paycheck in the Outer Banks. But soon one Northern boat will harvest the biggest fish so far this season.
